## Facilities (44)

Tier 1 is the most consequential (weights the city index ×3), tier 3 the least (×1). `base` is the normal operating level (0–1). Drainage sites carry a capacity threshold (`cap`, antecedent rainfall in mm), a response `scale` and a catchment memory `tau` (h), and the rain gauge they read. `people` is the modeled population within 1.2 km.
